payload.prompt: What is a cloud platform?

options.text: A collection of services used over the internet
options.rationale: Correct. A cloud platform provides a collection of services through the internet. It avoids requiring an organization to run everything on owned servers.
This describes compute rather than a whole cloud platform. Compute is one service category for running workloads.
options.better_fit: Choose this when an application needs capacity to run in the cloud.

feedback.intrinsic: This would identify only one service category.
feedback.instructional: A cloud platform includes compute and other internet-delivered services.

options.text: A managed platform for hosting applications
options.rationale: This describes App Services rather than the overall platform. App Services are one category within a cloud platform.
options.better_fit: Choose this when a team wants managed application hosting.

feedback.intrinsic: This would make the platform seem narrower than it is.
feedback.instructional: App Services are part of a broader cloud platform.

options.text: A service for retaining files and backups
options.rationale: This describes storage rather than a cloud platform. Storage is one category for saving and managing data.
options.better_fit: Choose this when files, databases, or backups must remain available.

feedback.intrinsic: This would omit the platform's other capabilities.
feedback.instructional: Storage is a service category within the larger platform.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. A cloud platform is a collection of services delivered through the internet.

payload.prompt: Which statements describe compute? Select all that apply.

Saving files and backups is storage's role. Compute runs work instead of providing persistent data retention.
options.better_fit: Choose this when data must remain available later.

feedback.intrinsic: This would assign a data-retention need to running capacity.
feedback.instructional: Storage keeps data, while compute runs workloads.

options.text: It provides managed app hosting without server management
options.rationale: Managed application hosting is the role of App Services. Compute is cloud capacity rather than a ready-made hosting platform.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the team wants to host an app without managing servers.

feedback.intrinsic: This would obscure the distinction between capacity and managed hosting.
feedback.instructional: Compute runs workloads; App Services provide managed application platforms.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Compute supplies cloud capacity for running applications, programs, and workloads.

payload.statement: Compute is mainly used to save and manage files, databases, and backups.

feedback.intrinsic: The program could remain slow because no execution capacity was added.
